text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Bright! That was a great race. You did
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's right, Bright! You really went all
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a wide course like this, Mejiro Bright
was able
to unleash her full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess I had nothing to fear. There was
no
unexpectedly powerful opponent...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was my performance? Did I
start my
spurt at the right time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to rush forward at the
perfect
moment for me, but... well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. My, I don't have a
single
care in the world right now! ♪
choice_data_list: これで正解だよ、ブライト

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright was able to run exactly
how she
wanted, unaffected by the
incredible event that is
the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you. I'm so glad we were
able to
spend this lovely time together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes... But that aside...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
While watching you today, I realized
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You did? Oh dear, what would that be?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You've perfected your own way of
running. That's
why you could smile out
there. But...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't. It's not because I lost. I couldn't
even if I
won.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's about running the way my heart
wants. You've
managed to do that, but I
haven't.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to pass you. I have to
pass this
trial... and see the beautiful
scenery I wanted to
today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I can't do that, then I can't be my true
self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I finally made up my mind. So I wanted
to... to
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let's race together again, Bright. I don't
think it
will be at the Kikuka Sho, but
someday, we'll race
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Let's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she realized something while
watching
Mejiro Bright. The Derby
means different things
to different
people, I suppose.
choice_data_list: いい勉強になったみたいだな、スズカも
いい勉強になったみたいだね、スズカも

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I usually like small flowers, but the
Kikuka Sho
refers to a chrysanthemum,
yes? Despite their
size, I love them too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Looking at them makes me feel bright
and proud.
I just want to say, "Look at
how lovely you are!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but ask. Rather than the
long-distance
Kikuka Sho, some runners
set their sights on
medium-distance
races during their classic year in
the fall.
choice_data_list: 『菊花賞』以外の道は考えなくていいか？
『菊花賞』以外の道は考えなくていい？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No. It has to be the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing to the Mejiro
family is
winning races of prestige such
as the Tenno Sho
and those in the
Classic Triple Crown. Plus...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What I want is what the Mejiros want.
That's all
there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's dream is unshakable.
With our
goal set on the Kikuka Sho, it's
time to start
training again.
